reason: It is the only measured recipe that meets the 95% quality target while cutting peak memory by about 16% versus int4-g128 (1,925 MiB vs 2,299 MiB). Its measured throughput also exceeds the int4 trials, but those samples are limited and do not establish repeatability. Recommend it as a hypothesis for the next comparison.
